items.title: Aggies to Battle Blue Raiders in Season Finale
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – Saturday at Johnny "Red" Floyd Stadium, NM State will conclude its 2026 campaign as they travel to take on Middle Tennessee. This will mark the eighth all-time meeting between the Aggies and Blue Raiders and the fourth time that the two sides collide in Murfreesboro, Tenn. This weekend's game will be available to stream on ESPN

items.title: Aggie Drop Home Finale Versus Delaware
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State completed its home slate on Saturday afternoon as it fell 42-30 to Delaware at Aggie Memorial Stadium. The Aggies carried a lead into the second half, but the Fightin' Blue Hens offense found the end zone four times in the final two quarters to pull away from the Crimson and White on Senior Day.

items.title: Gabe Peterson Named to Conference USA All-Academic Team
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – Aggie defensive end Gabe Peterson has been named one of just 11 student-athletes in Conference USA to be honored for his ability to excel in the classroom while also being one of the top competitors on the field.

items.title: NM State Hosts Delaware on Senior Day
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – For the final time during the 2026 season, NM State will return to Aggie Memorial Stadium as it is set to host Delaware on Senior Day. Saturday will mark the first all-time meeting on the gridiron between the Aggies and Fightin' Blue Hens. This weekend's game will be available to stream on ESPN+.

items.title: Brody Richter Earns CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week Honors
items.summary: DALLAS – After a career day on Saturday, Aggie punter Brody Richter has been named the Conference USA Special Teams Player of the Week for Week 11 based on a vote of media members from throughout the league.

items.title: NM State Suffers Overtime Defeat at Missouri State
items.summary: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. – NM State held a lead late into the fourth quarter, however, the Aggies were unable to exit with the victory as Missouri State used a late score to send the game into overtime where the Bears eventually defeated the Aggies 27-21.

items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State Football gets ready for its penultimate road contest of the 2026 season as it travels to take on Missouri State. The matchup will mark the 10th all-time meeting between the Aggies and Flames and fourth time the two programs square off in Las Cruces. items.title: Aggies Drop Home Contest to Jax State
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State returned home for its final Weekday CUSA contest of the 2026 season, falling 24-0 to Jax State on Wednesday at Aggie Memorial Stadium. NM State came away with a pair of interceptions, however, a pair of missed field goals and turnovers hurt the Aggies in the Conference USA matchup.
